g.title: j1443268490
g.text: n i see lil lightning amir standing at the super bruno bros cabinet

g.text: THE VOICES, TOO. BRUNO, LORENZO, MARUNO, MORENZO

g.text: n im not saying he was just imitating them im saying HE. FKING. WAS. THEM.

g.text: I wonder who else he can imitate.

g.text: don't blame him tho... with our history? probably thought i was gonna make fun of him or something

g.text: I think he's also just used to getting made fun of in general.

g.text: yeah... makes me regret not making it clear why i was so rough on him b4... wasnt cuz he's a clown. just didn't wanna see his ass get turned in2 roadkill... but anyway

g.text: 1st i asked him like - bro was that all srsly u?! like, all the voices?! srsly?!

g.text: i hadda ask him if it was all srsly him, right? like, all the voices?! srsly?!

g.text: N YEAH HE CAN DO ALL THE FKIN' VOICES, M8. EVEN PRINCESS PANAFORTE WTF

g.text: not only that but like he can do most the games in the friggin' arcadeeee, baaabes

g.text: Lol. This is seriously blowing your mind.
